news_headlines.title: Kyndryl, Google Cloud target AI workloads with local data control

This collaboration is designed to preserve data sovereignty, meet regulatory and latency requirements, and support AI-driven workloads by maintaining local control over data residency and governance. The partnership aims to accelerate application modernization and improve cost efficiency for AI and data intensive workloads.

The appointment underscores XBP Global's commitment to organizational readiness and human accountability in an AI-driven environment.

news_headlines.title: Las Vegas police lock in 5 more years of VR officer training

The market reacted positively to the news, with WRAP stock gaining 8.05%, reflecting increased institutional adoption of its non-lethal and training platforms.

news_headlines.title: A $260M AI buildout will put 2,304 Nvidia B300 chips in one U.S. site

The contract highlights a shift towards tailored, dedicated AI infrastructure solutions for enterprises, moving away from the constraints of traditional hyperscalers.
